name: media-engine
description: Multi-Platform Media Fetching, Streaming and In-App Playback Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,worker -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @media/shared" "npm run dev -w @media/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @media/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @media/shared && npm run build -w @media/api && npm run build -w @media/web --if-present
